answer: Each identity claims one terrace garden plot, locking a 70-credit bond to it. It files a zephyr seed-trap catch: seed count, mass, and trap distance. Auditors recompute dispersal from the zephyr wind-run table for that terrace level and seed mass; over 3% off, a reused serial, or a missing plot burns the bond. First filing costs 33; the kth under one key costs 33+6(k-1), so the 1000th costs 6027 and 1000 fakes cost 3,030,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-trap ring fails: one trap cannot give terrace-level distances at once. An honest garden owner pays 33 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
